mapping.A: black / dark navy shirts and shorts (numbers e.g. #6, #9); their goalkeeper wears light blue and defends the LEFT goal (seen 11-15 s)
mapping.B: white shirts with light-blue numbers (e.g. #7, #9, #15), black shorts; their goalkeeper wears orange and defends the RIGHT goal (seen 23-31 s)

method: frames extracted with cv2 at absolute frame round(t*30); 2-4x zoom strips at 0.1-0.2 s steps around every duel, frame-by-frame (0.033 s) at the duels of 2.7, 4.8, 7.0-8.1, 21.5-22.5, 24.5-26.6; result.json used only for team letters on people[] boxes (frames 1.0, 11.0, 21.0, 30.97) and the time range; audio spectrogram checked for a whistle (none distinguishable from shouting)
